name: vieclus
reference: Biedermann, Henzinger, Schulz & Schuster. Memetic Graph Clustering. SEA 2018. (KaHIP/VieClus, official Python interface, pinned pip vieclus==1.3.1, single-process)

leiden.doc: Use VieClus's Leiden mode, which guarantees connected communities. Off by default (standard memetic VieClus); an algorithm variant, not a tuned knob; set-only.

leiden_theta.doc: Leiden refinement temperature, only meaningful with --leiden. VieClus default 0.01; set-only.

cluster_upperbound.doc: Maximum cluster size; 0 leaves it unbounded. A size constraint, not a tuned knob; set-only. VieClus optimises plain modularity with no resolution parameter, so its only quality lever is the time budget (--time): Protocol A and B coincide, the same anytime-solver property as clustre-fast.
